headline: Executive order places protections on certain US-held property of Afghanistan's central bank, Da Afghanistan Bank, for the benefit of the Afghan people.
what_it_does: This order concerns property belonging to Da Afghanistan Bank, which is Afghanistan's central bank. Based on its title, it puts certain of that bank's property under protection and states that the property is to be used for the benefit of the people of Afghanistan. No summary was provided, so details such as which property is covered and how it may be used are not described here.

who_it_affects.how: Certain of its property is placed under protection by the US government under this order.
The order says the protected property is meant to be kept for their benefit.
